FULL TEXT:
Frequently Asked Questions
Q. In my certificate, number is not mentioned, what should I enter in certificate
no. field of online registration ?
Ans. Any unique no. mentioned in certificate as Registration No. / Roll No. / Date of issue
etc. has to be mentioned.
Q. I have just appeared in graduation (of qualifying education), am I eligible to
apply?
Ans. Go through the advertisement of respective posts.
Q. I do not find the university name in the list provided in application form, what
should I do?
Ans. Select the ‘Other’ option in the list-> a text box appeared. You have to write the name
of your University in the text box.
Q. My acknowledgement form is not generated, what should I do?
Ans. Please check below whether -
a) you have paid requisite fees as per your category/eligibility for the post applied for.
b) you have used correct challan for submission of fees.
c) you have entered correct Journal no. and date while registering online.
Please contact JPSC helpline (0651) 2213009 for any query.
Q. I have paid more than requisite fee, what should I do?
Ans. Your application is in order as far as payment is concerned.
Q. I have paid less than requisite fee, what should I do ?
Ans. Your candidature will get cancelled for paying less fee. You may fill the form again with
requisite fee.
Q. I have made a typing mistake while filling up online form, what should I do?
Ans. There is no such provision for correction in online form already submitted. You are
advised to fill the online form again with requisite fees.
